incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 5xx rate observed for /api/v1/generate across prod-us-west. Triggered alert 'api.5xx_rate > 1% for 5m'. Paging jonathan (SRE-oncall).

jonathan (SRE-oncall): I'm up, paging received. Looking at request traces and gateway logs.

maria (infra): I see a spike from the gateway to model-proxy: increased 504s and a few 502s starting ~5:03 UTC. Upstream latency to model-provider-1 is high.

jonathan (SRE-oncall): Confirmed: 5xx climbed from baseline 0.2% -> 3.6% between 05:02-05:10. Error distribution: 60% 504 gateway_timeouts, 30% 502 bad_gateway, 10% 500 internal. Affected routes mostly /api/v1/generate and /api/v1/stream.

lee (platform): Tagging the routing team. @patrick can you check if any rollout to model-provider-1 happened?

patrick (eng): No recent deploys on our side. The provider reported degraded performance in their status page 05:00 UTC. Paste: https://status.model-provider-1.example/incidents/ab12

jonathan (SRE-oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) Failover traffic away from model-provider-1 to provider-2 for non-low-latency customers, 2) Increase gateway timeouts slightly to reduce noisy 504s, 3) Temporarily suppress low-severity alerts for repeated gateway 504 bursts while we route.

maria (infra): I'm going to update the routing policy to steer 70% to provider-2, 30% remains to provider-1 for fallback. Applying now.

ops-bot: runbook action executed: updated routing policy for model-v1 -> weights {provider-1:30, provider-2:70}. (action-id: abcd-1234)

jonathan (SRE-oncall): After routing change, 5xx dropped to ~0.8% within 2 mins. Customer-facing errors reduced. Visible latency on provider-2 slightly higher but within SLO.

lee (platform): Good. Creating a temporary dashboard panel with rolling 5m/15m error rate + upstream latency. I'll add an annotation for this incident.

patrick (eng): Noting that some customers still saw tail errors. Sending a targeted retry rule to SDKs: if 504 and route==provider-1 then retry once to provider-2. Will coordinate with SDK release this morning.

jonathan (SRE-oncall): For alerting: current alert "api.5xx_rate > 1% for 5m" is too noisy for brief upstream provider blips. Proposed changes: - change threshold to 2% for 5m for global alert, - add a secondary alert that fires if 5xx_rate > 1% AND upstream_latency_p95 > 1s for 3m (so we only page when latency suggests systemic issue), - add an anomaly detector that looks for sustained delta > +1% from baseline over 30m.

maria (infra): I also recommend tuning the alert's evaluation window to 3m->5m and adding a suppression rule when routing changes are in-flight to avoid duplicate pages.

lee (platform): I'll create a Grafana dashboard and a Datadog monitor proposal (draft) with suggested queries. Example Datadog query for composite alert:

```
avg(last_5m):avg:aws.elb.5xx_count{env:prod,route:api_v1}/avg:aws.elb.request_count{env:prod,route:api_v1} > 0.02
```

And for combined condition: 5xx_rate > 0.01 AND avg(last_5m):p95:upstream.latency{provider:model-provider-1} > 1000

patrick (eng): Can we also add a runbook snippet for upstream provider failures with steps: reroute, increase autoscale, notify provider support, adjust alert thresholds, and post-customer communication template. I'll draft.

jonathan (SRE-oncall): Customer impact assessment: Based on logs, ~12 customers experienced elevated error rates; 3 customers reported degraded UX to support. No data loss. We should send a proactive message to those customers with a short summary and mitigation steps.

maria (infra): Action items (assigned):
- maria: Update routing playbook with provider weight example and rollback steps.
- lee: Create dashboard + Datadog monitor PR with the combined condition and suppression rules.
- patrick: Draft SDK retry patch and customer communication template.
- jonathan: Update oncall runbook to include upstream-provider failure flow and alert tuning proposals.

jonathan (SRE-oncall): I'll keep this thread live for handoff. Next oncall in 2h is lee. @lee assume if anything re-escalates after 07:00 UTC.

lee (platform): I'll take the handoff at 07:00. Please post final status + any open tasks before you drop.

jonathan (SRE-oncall): Final status at 06:20 UTC: routing adjusted, 5xx rate back to baseline ~0.35%, customer impact limited to a handful of users, provider-1 still showing intermittent latency. I've opened incident ticket INC-2026-439 with timeline and logs. Leaving open follow-ups for infrastructure and product comms.

ops-bot: incident-bot created INC-2026-439 and attached timeline.

patrick (eng): :thumbsup: I'll post the customer note draft in #customer-success for review.

lee (platform): Taking over handoff now. jonathan, please ping if anything changes.

jonathan (SRE-oncall): Handing off to lee. My pager is clear.

lee (platform): Thanks — I'll monitor the new dashboard and follow up on the alert PR.

maria (infra): Post-mortem notes: consider adding provider health as an input to routing decisions (circuit-breaker), and add automatic short-circuit to provider-2 when provider-1 latency exceeds threshold for 2m. Also, add a whitelist for low-latency customers to avoid routing changes for latency-sensitive traffic.

jonathan (SRE-oncall): Agree. We'll schedule an action review in the next oncall retro. Closing this thread for active paging. React if you want to add anything else. :white_check_mark:
